abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 5. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.
